info.title: sandbase/magi-2-reference-to-video
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "sandbase/magi-2-reference-to-video", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for sandbase/magi-2-reference-to-video; use POST /v2/models/sandbase/magi-2-reference-to-video/requests.

schema.description: Request body for Sandbase MAGI-2 reference-to-video. Send at least one reference: an image, a video or an audio clip.

example.prompt: The basketball player from image 2 walks into the jazz bar from image 1 and dances in front of the band.

audios.description: Up to 5 public HTTPS URLs of WAV or MP3 reference audio clips, 2 to 30 seconds each and 30 seconds in total.

duration.description: Video length in seconds, from 4 to 30. The charge is per second.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video. The price is the same with or without audio.

images.description: Up to 10 public HTTPS URLs of reference images, each under 30 MB.

prompt.description: Describe how to use the references, the scene, the motion and the sound.

seed.description: Optional seed for reproducibility. Omit it for a random seed.

videos.description: Up to 5 public HTTPS URLs of MP4 or MOV reference videos, 2 to 30 seconds each and 30 seconds in total.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for the Sandbase MAGI-2 ids: the completed `GET /proxy/sandbase/v1/run/{id}` run, forwarded unchanged. The video is at `outputs[0].url`. The URL is Sandbase's.

SandbaseRunError.description: Set on a failed or timed-out run.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output.

SandbaseRunResponse.description: A Sandbase run, returned both by a submit (status `pending`) and by `GET /proxy/sandbase/v1/run/{id}`.

id.description: Opaque run id. Use it exactly as returned.

model.description: The Sandbase model id, for example `sandai/magi-2/text-to-video`.

outputs.description: The generated outputs. Omitted while the run is not terminal, and also from a completed run whose output Sandbase has not yet transferred.

status.description: Status: pending, running, completed, failed or timeout.

usage.description: Model-specific usage details, when Sandbase reports them.
